devices.info.description: Get one device. Pass device_id, selection_id, or device_ref (exact display name/hostname).

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

devices.info.title: Device information

devices.list.description: List devices authorized for the current owner, including online status, immutable ID, platform, capabilities, and permission profile.
devices.list.title: List devices

devices.select.description: Resolve an exact device ID/name/hostname and mint a logical selection handle. MCP 2026 is stateless, so pass returned selection_id to later tools. Explicit device_id always overrides selection_id.

device.description: Immutable ID, exact display name, or exact hostname.

devices.select.title: Select device

fs.copy.description: Copy a file or directory on one device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.copy.title: Copy file

fs.delete.description: Delete a file or directory. Recursive directory deletion requires recursive=true.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.delete.title: Delete path

fs.list.description: List directory entries on a selected device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.list.title: List directory

fs.move.description: Move or rename a file or directory on one device.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.move.title: Move file

fs.patch.description: Apply exact search/replace patches to a UTF-8 regular file. Symlinks are refused unless follow_symlinks=true. Fails if a search block is missing or ambiguous unless replace_all=true.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.patch.title: Patch text file

fs.read.description: Read a bounded portion of a text or binary file. Binary data is returned base64 when encoding=base64.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.read.title: Read file

fs.search.description: Search names and optionally UTF-8 text below a root without following symlink directories. On capable Agents, exclude_dirs skips exact directory names (for example target, node_modules, .git); max_file_bytes bounds text scanning. Defaults preserve existing searches; .gitignore is not interpreted.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.search.title: Search files

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.write.description: Write or append text/base64 data using the Agent user's OS privileges. Requires STANDARD or FULL_CONTROL.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

fs.write.title: Write file

git.diff.description: Return a bounded Git diff. Supports staged and path filters.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.diff.title: Git diff

git.log.description: Return recent Git commits as structured records.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.log.title: Git log

git.run.description: Run a Git subcommand using argv (no shell interpolation). Requires STANDARD or FULL_CONTROL.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.run.title: Run Git

git.status.description: Return porcelain Git status for a repository without invoking a shell.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

git.status.title: Git status

process.list.description: List OS processes visible to the Agent user. filter is a case-insensitive literal substring, never regex. On capable Linux Agents, contains_any is OR over literals; pid, parent_pid, uid and Linux single-letter state narrow with AND. CPU time is cumulative seconds, RSS is resident host memory, not GPU memory.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.list.title: List processes

process.output.description: Read captured stdout/stderr for a process started by CommandCore. Existing external OS processes generally do not expose historical stdout and return output_unavailable. New native Linux captures expose per-stream retained/observed bytes, truncated, complete and last_output_at. Legacy truncation is unknown; incomplete capture cannot prove complete output.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.output.title: Process output

process.start.description: Start a shell command and return a process_id. Native Linux Rust Agents retain bounded job output and reconcile jobs across transport and Agent restarts. Legacy Agents retain output while running. Host reboot ends jobs; it does not automatically resume them.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.start.title: Start managed process

process.status.description: Inspect a CommandCore-managed process_id or an OS pid.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.status.title: Process status

process.stop.description: Terminate a CommandCore-managed process; may also signal an OS pid when permitted.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

process.stop.title: Stop process

shell.exec.description: Execute a command through the device's default shell. This is intentionally powerful and requires STANDARD/FULL_CONTROL. Output is bounded and audited; secrets should not be passed in command text.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

shell.exec.title: Execute shell command

system.info.description: Return hostname, OS, architecture, Python/Agent versions, boot time and hardware summary.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

system.info.title: System information

system.metrics.description: Return current CPU, memory, disk and load metrics. Capable Linux Agents also return health with contextual pressure conditions, Linux PSI, and optional accelerator utilization/memory plus compute PIDs. Unsupported metrics are explicit; unified/GPU memory can overlap host RAM. No automatic cleanup or termination.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

system.metrics.title: System metrics

transfer.download.description: Download a bounded file as base64. For large files a future streaming transfer capability will replace this Phase 1 mechanism.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

transfer.download.title: Download file

transfer.upload.description: Upload base64 data to a file on the selected device. Phase 1 payloads are bounded by server configuration.

device_id.description: Explicit immutable CommandCore device ID. Overrides selection_id.

transfer.upload.title: Upload file
